featured_reviews.name: Milind Gavkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really big and spacious play ground in Vasai!

Vasai Kala Krida Mahotsav is the annual attraction over here. Several outdoor and indoor games like running, chess, carom, table tennis, badminton, cricket, etc. are held on Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation (VVCMC) ground. Vasai Kala Krida Mahotsav has largest fan following in the vicinity. Many seasonedprofessionalls participate in abovementioned games.

Notably in chess, many internationally rated also known as 'FIDE rated' players do participates every year.

The play ground is available for the entire year for sports activities. It is nicely maintained by Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation.

The ground is aptly named as Chimaji Appa Ground in the memory of Chimaji Appa, was an Indian statesman and military commander of the Maratha Empire. Chimaji Aapa conquered the Vasai fort in his era.

featured_reviews.name: Aquib Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Up in the Air Trampoline Park, Vasai.

The biggest concern was safety. I noticed that part of the ceiling appeared damaged, with a section hanging down while children were playing directly underneath. As a parent or visitor, this is very worrying because it creates a potential safety risk if any loose material were to fall.

Another disappointment was the volleyball area. The court and nets were present, but there was no volleyball available. When I asked a staff member, I was told that balls were not being provided because the ceiling had been damaged due to people throwing them. If that’s the case, the attraction should either be properly maintained or temporarily closed instead of being left unusable.

The staff were also not very helpful. Some crew members seemed occupied on their phones, and getting assistance or proper responses was difficult. Customer service felt lacking throughout the visit.

To make matters worse, the air conditioning was either not functioning properly or not switched on despite the extreme summer heat. Spending time inside the facility became quite uncomfortable.

Maintenance overall appeared poor, especially considering the entry fee of around ₹400 per hour. For the amount being charged, visitors should expect a safe, well-maintained, and fully functional facility.

I also observed adults and children using the same trampoline areas at the same time, which did not seem to be monitored adequately. This raises additional safety concerns, particularly for younger children.

The property itself has a lot of potential and could be an excellent family entertainment destination, but in its current condition it feels neglected and poorly managed. Unfortunately, this visit was more frustrating than enjoyable, and I would not recommend it until major improvements are made in safety, maintenance, and customer service.

Definitely a good experience.

The kids’ area is especially wonderful — my children had a blast jumping, running, and exploring different games. The safety measures are top-notch, which gave us peace of mind while they played. The vibe of the place is energetic and cheerful, making it a perfect family outing spot.

There’s also a nice seating area for parents to relax while watching the kids enjoy. The lighting and décor add to the overall lively atmosphere. It’s a great place for birthday parties or group activities as well.

If you’re looking for a mix of fitness, fun, and family time, this is the place to go. Worth every penny and definitely a spot I’ll be visiting again.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited Post Office Restaurant, Vasai yesterday(19/4/2026) for a family dinner. This place has been special to us for many years, and we’ve always had great experiences—so this visit was genuinely disappointing.

To begin with, the staff seemed extremely confused, and there was no visible manager on the floor to handle operations. Everyone appeared to be working independently, with no coordination or proper system in place. Even placing an order was difficult—we had to call staff multiple times.

After ordering, the situation didn’t improve. The serving staff had no clarity about which dish belonged to which table. They kept moving around asking each table, “Did you order this?” which felt quite unprofessional.

We also noticed food and drinks sitting unattended on a side table for a long time. Unless guests themselves asked about their orders, nothing was being served. When the food finally arrived, it was cold, and the naan was chewy, which affected the overall dining experience.

To make matters worse, most tables—including ours—received incorrect bills with extra items added. This led to further delays as corrections had to be made.

Overall, there was a significant lack of management, coordination, and basic service standards. It resulted in a lot of wasted time and frustration.

We truly have many fond memories associated with this restaurant, which is why this experience was even more disappointing. We hope the management takes this feedback seriously, improves staff training, and restores the quality and service the place was once known for.

featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Thrillville with a group of friends and we had the time of our lives. featured_reviews.name: Jennifer Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited ThrillVille Entertainment Zone yesterday. While the overall concept of the place is good, we felt that several areas need much better maintenance, hygiene, and customer attention.

The go-karting experience was decent, but many of the cars did not seem to be maintained properly, which affected both the experience and the safety aspect.

Similarly, during the Splash Waterpark adventure, the water had a very unpleasant fishy smell and did not appear clean or regularly maintained. Hygiene is extremely important in water-based activities, and this was quite disappointing.

Another major concern was the staff behavior at the Splash Waterpark adventure area. Instead of actively supervising and assisting children, some staff members appeared more occupied enjoying themselves and were not attentive to kids who were struggling to climb back onto the adventure setup from the water. It felt like there was very little concern or support being provided, which was disappointing from a safety and customer service perspective.

Considering the amount charged for these activities, we expected a much better standard of upkeep, cleanliness, and staff involvement. Proper maintenance, regular cleaning, and more responsible staff supervision would greatly improve the overall experience.

Unfortunately, this visit did not meet our expectations, and personally, I may not consider visiting again. I sincerely hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and works on improving the facilities and service for future visitors.
